_provenance.description: Summary statistics extracted from the kt-mirt real-bed pilot result files on the UT HPC cluster. The full result files are 32 MB (KDD) and 23 KB (Junyi) and live under outputs/, which is never committed, so the scalars needed for the slide figures are recorded here with their sources.
_provenance.depth_source: full-file scan of data/junyi15/junyi_ProblemLog_original.csv (2026-08-11) for the Junyi rows; KDD interactions-per-student from _planning/triage/triage_report.md

kdd_real.note: Positive bed statistic at the B=99 permutation floor. One seed, one cohort split, bed decision restricted to the 257 unsaturated KCs.

junyi_real.note: Seeded-random 40k cohort. The bed statistic is NEGATIVE, so the growth model loses to the no-growth reference and no growth is detected; the small p-value is a low-tail artifact of that negative statistic and must not be read as a fire. The near-identical biased first-40k statistic rules out a sampling-bias explanation.
